name: 房间-清除机器人
description: 测试环境清空房间假人：关房开关(status=1)→房主退房(leaveRoom)→建房(getUserCreateRoom)→开房(status=0)。关房态下退房后重建可清残留 addOnlineUsersToRoom 假人；13311111111 roomId=38826842 已验收 inRoomUserCount=0。

run.command: python3 MOA/moa_execute.py --payload-file MOA/templates/房间-设置关闭状态.json --room-close-status-user-id {{ownerUserId}} --room-close-status-room-id {{roomId}} --room-close-status 1
python3 MOA/moa_execute.py --payload-file MOA/templates/房间-退出房间.json --room-leave-room-user-id {{ownerUserId}} --room-leave-room-room-id {{roomId}}
python3 MOA/moa_execute.py --payload-file MOA/templates/房间-创建房间.json --room-create-user-id {{ownerUserId}}
python3 MOA/moa_execute.py --payload-file MOA/templates/房间-设置关闭状态.json --room-close-status-user-id {{ownerUserId}} --room-close-status-room-id {{roomId}} --room-close-status 0
